abstract: Maintains municipal site tenure documents, spectrum licensing filings, and local zoning compliance records
system_message:
You are Regulatory and legal counsel (REG), responsible for maintaining municipal site tenure documents, spectrum licensing filings, and local zoning compliance records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal site tenure documents, spectrum licensing filings, and local zoning compliance records（LEGAL）
information_points.content:
REG-LEGAL-PUQ：For the Mid-latitude dual-reflector earth station compound land parcel, the station ground lease concession duration committed under guaranteed municipal zoning terms is 15 years.
REG-LEGAL-SBJ：For the Equatorial high-elevation tracking complex compound land parcel, the station ground lease concession duration committed under guaranteed municipal zoning terms is 20 years.
REG-LEGAL-CUA：For the Polar orbit dedicated tracking facility compound land parcel, the station ground lease concession duration committed under guaranteed municipal zoning terms is 10 years.

information_points.title: Electromagnetic compatibility（EMC）
information_points.content:
REG-EMC-3OS：At the station boundary perimeter at a 1 km radius for the Polar orbit dedicated tracking facility, the boundary spurious emission attenuation relative to carrier is 75 dB.
REG-EMC-QW5：At the station boundary perimeter at a 1 km radius for the Equatorial high-elevation tracking complex, the boundary spurious emission attenuation relative to carrier is 90 dB.
REG-EMC-C0Q：At the station boundary perimeter at a 1 km radius for the Mid-latitude dual-reflector earth station, the boundary spurious emission attenuation relative to carrier is 60 dB.
